title: Carry authenticated donor evidence through bundles
rootCause: The strict authority input admitted only the 22 required authority sources. It had no declared funding-evidence reference, so an extra bundle file was unreferenced and a bare FileRef would incorrectly require the raw transfer CSV to be JSON history. The pre-fix public CLI rejected rehearsalFundingEvidence as an unrecognized key. This was a transport/provenance contract defect, not global DTF scarcity.

contract.schema: Existing strict source schema extended with three literal restrictions; path, sha256, bytes, and provenance retain the existing source validation.
contract.compatibility: Already admitted v1 inputs omit the optional field and still export, load, and materialize. Their 22-role identity rule is unchanged. Both absent and present funding cases relocate twice in tests.
contract.transport: Existing walkReferences loads and verifies this explicitly typed raw source without parsing CSV as JSON. Existing writeBundle, readBundle, locate, complete, and materialization preserve exact bytes. Loader and materializer return the contained funding reference separately from sources.
contract.wrongPurpose: Incorrect ID or purpose rejects in the authority schema. The typed raw source cannot substitute for an authority source, preparation input, or accepted-configuration FileRef. A bare historical FileRef still requires JSON.
rejectedAlternatives: Replacing any authority document with the CSV
A CSV/JSON fallback for historical references
Treating a file hash as donor eligibility or financial approval
